name: pwsh
description: Execute a PowerShell command and return its stdout/stderr. Use PowerShell cmdlets (Get-ChildItem to list files, Get-Content to read a file, Select-String to search); paths are native Windows paths like C:\Users\name, and environment variables are $env:NAME.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI).

name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

name: glob
description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern.

name: write
description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to write. Provide file_path before content.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

name: edit
description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Absolute path to edit. Provide file_path before old_string.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Empty string deletes the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false.

name: web_search
description: Search the web for current information. Provide 1-4 queries; their results are merged. The result lists source URLs; use web_fetch to open one.

queries.description: 1-4 search queries; their results are merged.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.
